title: 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LF1LD_1LE0RD_1LB---_1LA0LA: the laws between eater phases, and a bottom word that grows
text: Over 12,482 phases the next fuel of an eater is built fresh by the hits it passes down (one rung per 11 hits, ratio 44/21, or per 21 hits, ratio 4; small offsets) or is an older run of the word. The arithmetic of such descents is proved in Lean (lean/Descent.lean). Below the eater the word is a list of staircases of runs a factor of 4 apart, and it grows: from 362 long runs to 5,257 in 12,000 phases. So the next right-end event is not getting closer and the bound stays at wall visit 108.73·10146. Three fixes let the accelerator run past phase 30 again.
